lastGame.title: Bills 31, Jets 12
stats: Josh Allen: 11-of-21, 196 yards, 1 TD, 1 INT; 2 rushing TDs (both 1 yard); passed Peyton Manning for most total TDs in a player's first 10 seasons
James Cook III: 18 carries, 157 yards, 74-yard TD run (career long, Bills' longest rushing TD since 2016)
DJ Moore: 4 catches, 90 yards, 45-yard TD; Dalton Kincaid had a career-long 54-yard catch
Defense: no TDs allowed, Jets 3-of-13 on third down; T.J. Parker 2 sacks, Dorian Williams first career sack
Jets QBs: Geno Smith 13-of-21, 148 yards before an ankle injury; rookie Cade Klubnik 11-of-20, 137 yards, 1 INT

news.h: Benford, Kincaid, Williams and Hamlin miss Thursday practice
news.b: CB Christian Benford (groin), TE Dalton Kincaid (thumb/ankle), LB Dorian Williams (calf) and S Damar Hamlin (toe) did not practice Thursday, and Benford, Kincaid and Williams have now missed both days. CB Dee Alford (concussion) was limited in a red non-contact jersey, G O'Cyrus Torrence (personal) was back as a full participant, and S Cole Bishop (shoulder) moved up to full. Game statuses come out with Friday's report.

news.h: Tyrell Shavers practicing in full after activation
news.b: Activated to the 53-man roster on Wednesday, WR Tyrell Shavers was a full participant Wednesday and Thursday as he returns from the ACL tear he suffered in last season's Wild Card game at Jacksonville. Joe Brady said a decision on his game-day status would come later in the week. Shavers had 23 catches for 245 yards and a TD in 2025.

news.h: Dolphins banged up on special teams, still need a kicker
news.b: Miami (1-8) waived K Zane Gonzalez on Nov. 16 after he missed two field goals and an extra point in a 24-22 loss at Indianapolis, and Jeff Hafley said the team would pick a replacement during the week. Punter Bradley Pinion (groin) did not practice Wednesday or Thursday, long snapper Tucker Addington (shoulder) was limited, and C Aaron Brewer (concussion) was limited Thursday.

news.h: 'One game at a time' with Thanksgiving looming
news.b: At 8-1 and on a five-game winning streak, Josh Allen called Sunday "another opportunity to go 1-0 against a division opponent," with the Chiefs coming to town on Thanksgiving night. Ed Oliver has only one sack, but since Week 8 he ranks second in the NFL with 16 pressures and has a 23.5% pressure rate, per TruMedia.

source: buffalobills.com Week 11 injury report (Wed/Thu, Bills and Dolphins) and Shavers activation; SI Bills OnSI Thursday practice update (Nov 19); UPI on Dolphins waiving Gonzalez (Nov 16); ESPN standings checked Nov 20 (no AFC East game Thursday; Colts beat Texans 26-3).
